name: Hearthlift Courier V3 · Difficulty 4 · Full Interaction
natural_language: Load the ember crate and wake the lifts. Carry it across the moving lift stacks. Drag the courier in the overhead chart toward an intended landing spot and release to hop. E burns the crate. The aim sets speed for a nominal 1.6s hop; elevation and inherited lift motion change the landing. Click a moving lift top in the overhead chart to inspect its concealed motor survey. Its next 3.2s of motion then appears in both views and stays live once inspected. Inspect safely from the quay before hopping; inspection does not launch the courier or pause the lifts. Land inside a top, burn at the hearth, and certify. Falling or releasing away from the hearth ends the episode. A rejected CERTIFY DELIVERY also ends the episode. Aim previews, canceled aims and rejected out-of-range aims remain recoverable.
